the_bug_that_validates_the_design.what_the_model_proposed: three actions: click filter, type urgent, click APPLY
the_bug_that_validates_the_design.what_the_page_needed: ONE action -- the first click assigns the value and redraws
gate_verdicts: step 1 refused at first with THE_PAGE_MOVED_OUTSIDE_THE_NAMED_WIDGET (outside=0.0071) because the claim named only the box while the list and heading also changed -- the gate was right, the claim was wrong
after correcting the claim, step 1 CAUSAL_OK and step 2 refused with NOTHING_CHANGED_BUT_A_CHANGE_WAS_CLAIMED -- the model over-planned and the gate caught it
the_bug_that_validates_the_design.why_it_matters: on a page with no structure at all, the division still held: the model decided, the gate verified, and the gate was correct both times it fired

what_this_says_about_anything_on_a_compu.not: a single mechanism that handles any computer use
what_this_says_about_anything_on_a_compu.but: a ladder with a cheap rung and an expensive one, and a FIRST STEP that measures which rung it is on before acting
what_this_says_about_anything_on_a_compu.the_honest_gap: the expensive rung is what every computer-use agent does by default, and it is why OSWorld-class scores sit near 20%. The cheap rung is only reachable where the interface declares itself.
